summary: Tier-3 in-tree mutation probe demonstrating that the R-1 guard (packages/operator-core/lib/__tests__/report-cargo-tests.test.ts) genuinely fails when the behaviour it asserts is broken. Dropping the 'debug' profile from CARGO_PROFILE_DIR_NAMES (scripts/lib/cargo-result.mjs:289) took the suite from 57/57 passing to 10 failed / 47 passed, so the mutant was CAUGHT: MUTATION_PROBE_RESULT verdict=caught expected=caught target=in-tree:lock-held baseline_exit=0 guard_exit=1 mutant_parse=ok. Probe exit 0 means the guard failed on the mutant, which is the success condition for falsifiability. Run under locks:acquire on scripts/lib/cargo-result.mjs (lock 856380aa-304b-42bd-833e-31f90938c601) per the sweep-race rule, and the probe verified the file byte-identical to its pre-probe state afterwards. Tested at HEAD 765418ba63 with the tested path reported clean (TEST_FILE_PROVENANCE uncommitted=0). Recorded via testing:record-run because mutation-probe runs can never reach the Vitest ledger themselves: the probe exports PAPERCUSP_MUTATION_PROBE=1 (scripts/mutation-probe.sh:738) and admin-test-runs-reporter.ts:298 deliberately skips those runs, since a mutant red is falsifiability evidence rather than repository-health evidence.
